item.title: October 21, 2026: Attic Air Sealing + Blown Cellulose (R-19 to R-60): Stack-Effect Payback & 25C Credit Math
item.description: Counter-Intuitive Takeaway: Blowing 14 inches of R-49 fiberglass over unsealed drywall top plates and recessed can lights loses up to 38% of its rated R-value to convective winter air loops. Spending the first $180 on polyurethane foam gun sealing around plumbing stacks and wire penetrations yields 3x the BTU reduction per dollar of insulation depth alone.
